scope: Independent saved raw/count/source/paired-statistic audit only; stdlib+NumPy, no project imports
old_reference_scope: Byte hashes plus predetermined old gate key only; no old native cohort recount or rerun

receipt.scope: Existing project configuration inventory; no raw outcomes read or receiver/generator called

reservation.limit: Disjoint within recorded configuration inventory, not a claim about unregistered outputs

primitive_scope: Terminal2 full +1 nativejoint and one stage1 per key; excludes SBL linear-algebra work and upstream transforms
input_binding_scope: Saved original priors rehashed; selected atoms/energies bind support/h0; y/pilot/coded hashes bound to generation/fingerprint receipts. Bit arrays and header tensors not reconstructed; source-qualified original pipeline and old-key codeword/decoder gate retained.

independent_bootstrap.method: Direct default_rng integers(0,50,(10000,50)); same joint frame draws for all4cells/all3arms; actual sampled-row denominator; no producer summarize/paired imports

limits: Fresh frames under the same frozen P1 law; design informed by old cohorts.
Pointwise two-candidate score comparisons; no familywise selection claim, equivalence/noninferiority, unique mechanism or deployment acceptance.
Instrumented shared SBL work and diagnostic receiver timings; no optimized latency superiority claim.
